headline: Broadcom Rival Marvell Surges After Google Strikes AI Chip Deal, Gets Option to Buy $12.2B Stake
summary: Marvell surges after a Google AI chip deal gives Alphabet a warrant tied to nearly 59 million shares and as much as $120 billion in revenue.
